ABOUT.TITLE: About us
ABOUT.WHO_WE_ARE.TITLE: Who We Are
ABOUT.WHO_WE_ARE.DESCRIPTION: "Forsa" is an innovative platform established to promote a culture of volunteering and empower individuals to find opportunities that align with their interests and aspirations. The platform serves as a bridge connecting volunteers with entities in need of support across various fields.
ABOUT.VISION.TITLE: Our Vision
ABOUT.VISION.DESCRIPTION: To be the leading platform in fostering a culture of volunteering and creating a positive impact in the community by engaging everyone in building a better future.
ABOUT.MISSION.TITLE: Our Mission
ABOUT.MISSION.DESCRIPTION: We aim to provide an integrated and secure environment that allows individuals to easily discover volunteering opportunities and actively contribute to community causes while building strong collaboration between entities and volunteers.
ABOUT.GOALS.TITLE: Our Goals
ABOUT.GOALS.EMPOWER_INDIVIDUALS: Empower individuals to volunteer in alignment with their skills and interests.
ABOUT.GOALS.SUPPORT_ORGANIZATIONS: Support entities and community initiatives by providing qualified human resources.
ABOUT.GOALS.FOSTER_COLLABORATION: Foster community collaboration and promote social responsibility.
ABOUT.GOALS.BUILD_DATABASE: Build a comprehensive database of volunteering opportunities across Kuwait.
ABOUT.FOUNDERS.TITLE: Founders
ABOUT.FOUNDERS.HIND_BIO_1: She brings over 11 years of experience in the banking sector and more than 10 years of expertise in technical analysis of financial markets.
ABOUT.FOUNDERS.HIND_BIO_2: In 2024, she was named among Binance’s Top 60 Cryptocurrency Influencers.
ABOUT.FOUNDERS.HIND_BIO_3: She also has over 4 years of experience in managing social media accounts.
ABOUT.FOUNDERS.KHALED_BIO_1: A visionary entrepreneur and the founder of Talabat. He is also the co-founder of Floward, Al-Hisba, and the founder of the Oogoo App.
ABOUT.FOUNDERS.KHALED_BIO_2: He has received numerous national awards and was named one of Kuwait’s Top Entrepreneurs by Forbes in 2023.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy – Forsa Platform
PRIVACY.DATA_PROVIDED_DIRECTLY_1: When registering as a volunteer or as an Entity/volunteer team.
PRIVACY.DATA_PROVIDED_DIRECTLY_2: When applying for a volunteering opportunity or contacting our team.
PRIVACY.DATA_PROVIDED_DIRECTLY_3: May include name, email, phone number, gender, date of birth, and information you provide in your profile.
PRIVACY.DATA_COLLECTED_AUTOMATICALLY_1: IP address, device and browser type, language, geolocation data.
PRIVACY.DATA_COLLECTED_AUTOMATICALLY_2: Browsing history and interactions with site pages.
PRIVACY.HOW_WE_USE_DATA_1: Match you with suitable volunteering opportunities.
PRIVACY.HOW_WE_USE_DATA_2: Enable Entites to contact you when you are accepted for a volunteering opportunity.
PRIVACY.HOW_WE_USE_DATA_3: Improve the user experience and develop the platform's services.
PRIVACY.HOW_WE_USE_DATA_4: Send notifications or updates about opportunities or your account activity.
PRIVACY.HOW_WE_USE_DATA_5: Prepare reports and statistics (after removing personally identifying information).
PRIVACY.DATA_SHARING_1: We share your basic data (such as name and email) with partner Entites only when you sign up for a volunteering opportunity.
PRIVACY.DATA_SHARING_2: We do not sell your data to any third party.
PRIVACY.DATA_SHARING_3: We may disclose your data if required by law or to protect our rights or the rights of our users.
PRIVACY.DATA_SHARING_4: We reserve the right to use anonymized data (not linked to your identity) for research or statistical purposes.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_TRACKING_1: We use cookies to improve your experience and personalize content.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_TRACKING_2: You can control cookies in your browser settings but disabling them may limit some platform features.
PRIVACY.DATA_SECURITY_1: We apply technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access or loss.
PRIVACY.DATA_SECURITY_2: However, no data transmitted over the internet can be guaranteed 100% secure.
PRIVACY.DATA_RETENTION_1: We retain your data as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the services.
PRIVACY.DATA_RETENTION_2: You have the right to access and update your data.
PRIVACY.THIRD_PARTY_LINKS_1: The site may include links to external websites or apps.
PRIVACY.THIRD_PARTY_LINKS_2: Your use of them is subject to their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for them.
PRIVACY.ADVERTISING_PROMOTIONAL_1: We may display non-volunteering events or promotional content in dedicated sections.
PRIVACY.ADVERTISING_PROMOTIONAL_2: We may use data (e.g., pages you visit) to show content closer to your interests.
PRIVACY.ADVERTISING_PROMOTIONAL_3: We do not share your personal data directly with advertisers, but some ads may be served via external providers with their own policies.
PRIVACY.PHOTOS_MEDIA_INTRO: Photos or videos may be taken during events by:
PRIVACY.PHOTOS_MEDIA_USAGE: These materials may be used for documentation, awareness campaigns, or published on Forsa's official social channels.
PRIVACY.PHOTOS_MEDIA_CONSENT: Your attendance at the event constitutes consent to the possibility of your appearance in photos or videos.
PRIVACY.PHOTOS_MEDIA_RESPONSIBILITY: We are not responsible for photos or videos produced by independent media outlets.
PRIVACY.POLICY_CHANGES_1: We may update this policy from time to time.
PRIVACY.POLICY_CHANGES_2: We will notify you of any material changes via email or on-site notice.
PRIVACY.POLICY_CHANGES_3: Your continued use of the platform after changes indicates your acceptance of them.
TERMS.TITLE: Terms & Conditions – Forsa Platform
TERMS.WELCOME_MESSAGE: Welcome to Forsa, the innovative platform that promotes a culture of volunteering and connects individuals with Entites. By using our website, you agree to these Terms & Conditions as well as our Privacy Policy.
TERMS.DEFINITIONS_1: Platform/We/Forsa: The legal entity operating the "Forsa" platform.
TERMS.DEFINITIONS_2: User: Any person who creates an account or uses the platform.
TERMS.DEFINITIONS_3: Volunteer: A user who applies to or participates in a volunteering opportunity.
TERMS.DEFINITIONS_4: Organizer: Any entity (association, foundation, volunteer team, company, etc.) that creates opportunities or manages events via the platform.
TERMS.DEFINITIONS_5: Opportunity: Any volunteer activity/opportunity published on the platform.
TERMS.DEFINITIONS_6: Content: Any text, image, video, or other material uploaded by users or published by the platform.
TERMS.ACCEPTANCE_CHANGES_1: Your access to and use of the site mean you accept these Terms and the Privacy Policy.
TERMS.ACCEPTANCE_CHANGES_2: Forsa reserves the right to modify the Terms from time to time. We will notify you of changes via an in-site notice or email within a reasonable period before they take effect. Your continued use after the effective date means you accept the updated version.
TERMS.REGISTRATION_ACCOUNTS_1: The platform accepts registration by individuals (citizens or residents) from age 7 and above.
TERMS.REGISTRATION_ACCOUNTS_2: Minors (under 18): Registration and participation must be under the supervision and with the consent of a parent/legal guardian and are under their full responsibility.
